title: Which order made this?
explanation: The cheap, bold, and creative labels and the rainy-day verdict only appear when the order asks for those three types and a judgment on one criterion. Option D asks for three, but gives no labels and no verdict.
output:

Option B (bold): A sunrise hike.

Best for a rainy day: Option C, because it can be done indoors.
